outcome: inconclusive on live infrastructure; premise confirmed offline
finding: The live run could not be attributed to phases. Decisions were split by median scored_at over a 20-minute window, and that window also contained an unrelated 1,200-transaction producer run from 18 minutes earlier, so both 'phases' were mixtures. The recall figures recorded in the first version of this file are therefore meaningless and have been withdrawn.

offline_check.what: XGBoost on the enriched feature set, trained on 800k PaySim rows, threshold tuned on the validation split (0.9833). Each generator from scripts/produce_transactions.py scored 400 times with Feast defaults, which is what a first-time sender gets.
offline_check.conclusion: The shifted profile evades the model completely while normal traffic is almost never flagged. The demo's premise holds; the live analysis was at fault, not the scenario.

fixes: The producer now tags ground_truth.source with the generator used, so phases are attributed exactly rather than inferred from timestamps.
demo_performance_drop.py reports recall per generator at the end of the run.
tests/test_pipeline_smoke.py asserts the premise, so it cannot regress silently.
still_untested_live: A clean live run on an idle stack, with Feast materialised. Not repeated here because the stack was torn down and the offline check is decisive about the model's behaviour.
